objective: Implement Phase B: Persistent Data Storage and Backend Foundation with Anonymous Workspace Isolation
acceptance_criteria: Relational schemas defined for Projects, Sources, Findings, Decisions, Tasks, Risks, Dependencies, Questions, Evidence, Reviews, and Handovers
Persistent storage layer implemented: PostgreSQL-ready relational architecture with durable workspace repository
Anonymous workspace mechanism provides complete multi-visitor isolation with zero login, zero signup, and 100% Incognito compatibility
Backend REST API routes implemented under /api/... for workspace, project, source, finding (approve, reject, edit, resolve-conflict), and handover certification
State mutations in ProjectContext communicate with persistence layer so that approvals, edits, notes, and handover certifications survive page refresh
Pre-seeded Project Titan Handover demo dataset automatically initializes for fresh anonymous workspaces
Automated unit and integration tests verify persistence layer, API handlers, and workspace isolation
Existing Phase A handover integrity rules and Google Stitch design tokens strictly preserved
Production build and typecheck pass with zero errors
non_goals: Do not introduce login, signup, user registration, or authentication gates
Do not start real AI integration or document processing in this phase
Do not break Phase A handover integrity rules
Do not alter Google Stitch visual layout or warm sage design tokens

verification.result: 18/18 tests passed (Phase A: 8/8, Phase B: 10/10 covering Scenarios A-G, security validation, and gating). Production build succeeded with 0 errors (10 dynamic API routes and 6 static pages generated).
